decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line that has stayed visible on the website for two years, its option value is still being realized at low carrying cost, so keeping it fits the firm's organic expansion direction.

The premium snack line is extending into new variants (Classic and Geflügel), which signals continued investment, but its drop from a page of its own to a mention adds some uncertainty that is not yet resolved enough to justify dropping it.
This organic Fleischwurst was launched recently and is featured on a page of its own, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little within the existing production setup.
This new organic chicken line fits the firm's push into organic and new formats, and with uncertainty unresolved after one year, the option is worth holding.

This single organic salami variant is close to the core offer and cheap to carry, though it faces some risk of assortment pruning given the firm's many parallel organic options, as the delisting of B already showed.
